principal_history.assessment_notes: Complete written original physical2–20 reviewed, plus cover1 as metadata; listening21–36 excluded. Principal supplies69 scored questions,12 shared contexts and a STAR worked example, with useful selective ruby and continuous complete section coverage. It is the stable full-page comparison reference, not an assertion that this distributor edition is the cleanest or official. 米拉 physical3–19 and Ver2.0 physical1–33 were reviewed in full as comparison witnesses.
